gold: Syringocystadenocarcinoma papilliferum in situ (SCACPIS) arising in a precursor lesion of syringocystadenoma papilliferum (SCAP) with macular amyloidosis

selector.rationale: Hidradenoma papilliferum best explains the clinical and histopathological findings, including the presence of a well-defined erythematous plaque with overlying ulceration and a tumor with apocrine epithelial lining, papillary projections, and vascular stroma.

rejected.label: Amyloidosis
rejected.why: Lack of strong evidence and presence of amyloid deposits not directly related to the primary lesion

rejected.label: Syringocystadenoma papilliferum
rejected.why: Limited evidence and less specific findings compared to Hidradenoma papilliferum

rejected.label: Apocrine gland carcinoma
rejected.why: Although some atypical cells and mitotic figures are present, there is no dermal invasion, making this diagnosis less likely
